uncited: The method builds on the shared principles of Tensorial and Low-Rank Representations [11617-tensorial-and-low-rank-representations.md], specifically using sparse tri-vector radiance fields.
The radiance field is represented using a multi-scale tri-vector structure.
**Sparse Selection:** For each sample point, identify the relevant tensor components.
**Optimization:** Update the tensor factors using gradient descent, applying regularization as per the parent method's principles [11617-tensorial-and-low-rank-representations.md].
This is the standard multi-scale configuration of Strivec, serving as the baseline from which the Fast Variant is derived.
The method is part of the broader family of tensorial and low-rank representations for neural radiance fields [11617-tensorial-and-low-rank-representations.md].
